The part is two round legs, 10 mm in diameter, standing parallel to Z with their centres 10 mm apart along X. A half-torus bend joins them at the top. The leg at −X runs 32 mm below the bend and the leg at +X runs 22 mm. The whole part is 20 × 10 × 42 mm and is a single valid solid. The STEP file was read back and matched the part.

The leg lengths were found by trial against the comparison renders. I swapped which leg is longer once to check the direction, and the score dropped to 0.80, so the longer leg is at −X.

The part was made with a CadQuery script. AgentCAD warns that it isn't a native PartDesign feature tree, which doesn't matter for a STEP submission.
